description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging with optional chaining to other LogNode implementations. It serves as an adapter within a logging framework, allowing messages to be logged with different levels and optional exception details.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class implementing LogNode that wraps Android's Log utility, facilitating log message output and chain forwarding.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to forward log messages to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional exception; then forwards to the next node if present.
